# Quantum Phase-Space Rigidity (0TH-2026-020) — Full LLM Context Guide

Author: Alexander Stephen Donahue (ORCID 0009-0006-8168-9648, Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA)
Repository: https://github.com/0thernes/quantum-phasespace-rigidity

## 1. Pillar I — Complete Cyclic Z_{2l}-Stabilizer AME(N, 2l) Classification (T1a–T1e)
Resolves and generalizes Wójcik, Makuta, Bruzda, Augusiak (arXiv:2603.18193v3) and extends Cha (arXiv:2603.13442v2):
- Theorem T1a: Radical divisor descent (d -> m | d), prime-power Hensel ascent, CRT lifting, and universal unimodular graph states (K_2, K_3, C_5, Prism_6, W_5 — all 20 3x3 cross-minors in {+1, -1}) giving AME(N, d) for ALL d >= 2 at N in {2, 3, 5, 6}.
- Theorem T1b: Universal Pless moment obstruction for prime p | d: even N >= 2p^2 and odd N >= 2p^2 + 2p + 1 impossible.
- Theorem T1c: Exact Rains shadow obstructions for N in {4, 7, 9, 11}: S_0(4) = -1/2, S_1(7) = 7/4 not in Z, S_1(9) = -9/4, S_3(11) = -165/8, plus 0/64 binary graphs at N=4 (132/1,024 at N=5).
- Theorem T1d: Torsion Singleton p-rank forcing (dim_{F_2} G[2] = N) for arbitrary non-canonical/non-free cyclic Z_{2l}-stabilizers + additive F_4-MDS impossibility at N=7 (A_6 = -21 < 0) and odd N >= 9 (B_{k+2} = 3*C(2k+1,k+2)*(3-k) < 0).
- Theorem T1e: Complete dichotomy — cyclic Z_{2l}-stabilizer AME(N, 2l) exists iff N in {2, 3, 5, 6}. Sharp Ring-vs-Field separation at (4,4): Z_4 impossible vs. explicit Galois F_4 generator matrix realizable.

## 2. Pillar II — Maximal-Cardinality Resolvable Quantum Latin Squares (T2a–T2d)
Resolves open questions of Zhang & Cao (arXiv:2608.29201v2), breaking their t <= 2 barrier:
- Theorem T2a: Two-frequency Fourier lift |psi_{x,y}> = q^{-1/2} sum_{z in F_q} zeta_p^{Tr(y*z + x*mu(z))} |z> achieves maximal cardinality q^2 iff mu is not F_p-linear, and admits t mutually orthogonal transversal classes from undetermined directions c of mu. For every odd prime p >= 7, Megyesi's QR/NQR permutation gives maximal-cardinality ((p-5)/2)-RQLS(p) (first-ever t >= 3: 3-RQLS(11), 4-RQLS(13), 6-RQLS(17), 7-RQLS(19), ...).
- Theorem T2b: Kernel-checked + zero-float C++20 Z[zeta_p] certified 2-RQLS(9) (6,561 pairs), 3-RQLS(11) (14,641 pairs), 4-RQLS(13) (28,561 pairs), char-2 3-RQLS(16) (65,536 pairs), and 6-RQLS(17) (83,521 pairs) — 198,820 pairs total, 0 off-diagonal collinear.
- Theorem T2c: Direct-product composite lifts: untwisted Q_1 x Q_2 (3-RQLS(143), 3-RQLS(176)) and unitary-twisted Q_1 x_D C_2 (3-RQLS(55)).
- Theorem T2d: Zero-gap F_8 obstruction: every orthomorphism of F_8 fixing 0 is F_2-linear (0/4,872 nonlinear permutations vs. 84 on F_7).

## 3. Pillar III — Basis-Independent Magic Geometry & Symplectic Marginal Descent (T3a–T3d)
Resolves Zurel & Davis (arXiv:2602.22336v2, Sec. V.3) and strengthens Liu et al. (arXiv:2512.16777v2, Thm 10):
- Theorem T3a: Exact Gurvits-Barnum Cor. 3 identity ||(D-1)rho - I_D||_2^2 <= 1 <=> Tr(rho^2) <= 1/(D-1) equates R(AWP_0) = 1/sqrt(D(D-1)) with the bipartite separability ball, proving ASTAB_{2,d} subset AWP_{2,d} subseteq ASEP_{2,d} for all odd primes d >= 3 and all-bipartition biseparability for all n >= 2. Conversely, 2-qubit ASTAB and ASEP are strictly incomparable via rational witnesses rho_ent = diag(11,3,3,3)/20 (V_A = +1/10) and rho_sep = diag(8,7,4,1)/20.
- Theorem T3b: Exact closed-form circumradii R^2(ASTAB_{2,2}) = 3(13+4*sqrt(3))/484 > 1/12 and R^2(ASTAB_{1,3}) = (7-3*sqrt(5))/6 in (1/24, 1/6).
- Theorem T3c: Symplectic Marginal Descent averages exact C_2 = 2 (240 CNC m=1 vertices of Lambda_2) over Sp(2n, 2) to prove C_n <= (7*4^n + 8)/(15*2^n) <= 2^{n-1} < 2^n, yielding an exact unconditional 15/7x squared-inball-radius gain for every n >= 2.
- Theorem T3d: Clifford-Reynolds Degree-2 RLT+SOS Barrier proves M >= 4^n - 1 (Tr(X^2) <= 2^n) for any degree-2 RLT+SOS certificate over Lambda_n.

## 4. Verification Architecture & Epistemic Boundaries
- 6-kernel Lean 4.35.0 (zero Mathlib, zero sorry/admit/native_decide, strictly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]).
- 7 polyglot engines: Lean 4, Rust 1.94 (#![forbid(unsafe_code)]), Zig 0.17 (comptime), C++20 (Z[zeta_p]), ISO C11 + x86-64 NASM + Moonlab + QGTL + QRNG, Eshkol Dual-AD, Python 3.12 exact oracle + 6/6 mutation kill.
- Mega-Atlas V2 cross-check: 0/1,900 grand open problems claimed.
